# Finite-range supply of a prepared clock's data interaction

Can a finite clock drive the fixed literal data box without interactions whose
range grows with the clock's length? The construction below gives a conditional
answer using an explicit auxiliary path for each data Pauli word. The original
finite data Hamiltonian H remains present at its original coordinates and
coefficients throughout the full supplied runtime.

The unchanged 28,389-byte proof, SHA-256
`8831f7bf0398f59780ca965539d9c9be70ec9137add5c3d6d219c895c3fb79b6`,
was accepted as conditional analytic support at 17:03:26.985595 UTC on
14 October 2026. Root acceptance is
`d43e7e796d9b879e272e3682e6b17ec4cbc26e38122f242c201b1aba7b5a7de2`.
The original proof's pending-review sentences are historical. Root accepted
source assembly b107cca7 under LOCAL_CLOCK_DATA_ASSEMBLY_ROOT_ACCEPTANCE.json
1b26b769 and complete review 911b69e7. This publication source and driver require
separate exact root acceptance; no retained audit or physical-law authority is supplied.

The comparison starts with the parent's compact one-excitation open-path clock,
all MN auxiliary qubits in their bare zero state, and arbitrary data, dirty
transit and passive reference allowed by the supplied word contract. There is
no initial-K restriction on the data. A full auxiliary-space positive penalty
and exact response calculation give an explicit finite-time operator bound
`E_med = A1/sqrt(Delta) + A2/Delta`. Combining it with the accepted open-path
bound gives `E_path + E_med` on prepared maps and twice that sum on complete
joint trace distance, before the other stated preparation, control, timing and
readout allowances. Both unnormalized admission branches and their internal
coherences are retained; this is not postselection.

For the fixed ordinary box `{0,...,63}^3`, the full one-site/two-neighbor Pauli
inventory has at most 7,753,728 words and 57 incidences at a data site. The new
terms have arity at most three and range at most `M+190`, independent of clock
length and requested accuracy only because that data inventory is fixed.
Clock and individual auxiliary path bonds are ordinary nearest neighbor;
cross-chain and data-root bonds can have the stated very large range. The
original H and its seam/high-arity terms remain supplied. This does not give a
whole-apparatus nearest-neighbor or data-size-uniform construction.

All N clock qubits, MN clean auxiliaries, signed couplings, inverse-response
growth, counterterms, scalar shifts, complete runtime and precision costs are
charged. Couplings may grow exponentially. The energy ledger retains the
`Delta Q0` contribution to the second moment and all logical covariances;
small auxiliary leakage probability does not mean small penalty energy.
A sufficient full-space nonnegative-energy bound uses the separately stated, paid scalar reserve.
Neither the chosen energy zero nor positivity identifies a native energy law.

Three exact mathematical roles are used. [Positive prepared open-path clock](POSITIVE_OPEN_PATH_CLOCK_BOUNDED_THEOREM_NOTE_2026-10-14.md) supplies
the actual positive clock, compact initial packet, signed samples, free-clock
comparator and prepared-map error. [Fixed-background control](LITERAL_L4_FIXED_BACKGROUND_CONTROL_BOUNDED_THEOREM_NOTE_2026-10-14.md)
supplies original H, full signed waveform including scalar phase and actual
waits, and the full-word certificate. [Autonomous waveform interface](LITERAL_L4_AUTONOMOUS_CLOCK_BRIDGE_BOUNDED_THEOREM_NOTE_2026-10-14.md)
supplies smoothing and the full-reference prepared interface inherited by that
path. Complete original bodies are bound at their exact published identities;
these narrower roles govern. No initial-K recovery, separate neutral-ray,
critical-mediator, balanced-coupling or record-window theorem is imported.

The actual procedural stack is regular PR9564 at 03836ecd8c9921aa1a3f12c2e1dbfcd21e7b021e on physics-loop/toe-open-path-clock-20261014. Its open-path mathematical role follows the source use above, not ancestry.
Current PARENT_BINDINGS.json is authoritative. The original assembly dependency
snapshot, body/footer statuses and earlier pending binding remain historical.
The graph proposal follows the three actual citations; no graph program was run.

Generic perturbative mediation and mediator-qubit gadgets are prior art. The
source's Kempe–Kitaev–Regev and Oliveira–Terhal references are abstract-level
attribution, not imported spectral or geometric theorems or a novelty survey.
The finite-time residual proof below is explicit. The two historical selected
calculations have distinct controls but shared model/parent and same-model
limitations; they are not interval certificates or evidence for native supply.

Joint preparation, couplings, calibration, external preparation timing/drift
control, terminal time and any classical reader remain supplied. Mathematical
dephasing does not construct a reader. Storage, stopping and reset are separate
interfaces. The result is finite, conditional and potentially expensive.

The complete original proof begins below. Its bytes, including historical
status and exposure wording, are unchanged.
